icons.description: A form field rejects its value. Light: the exclamation mark beside the field strikes down onto its dot, and a beat later the field shakes its head: it jolts left, swings back right and settles, carrying the typed value with it. Strong: the stem lifts first and strikes harder, the dot is knocked down and rebounds, and the field shakes three times, each smaller. The exclamation stays beside the field.

icons.name: password-strength
icons.heading: Password strength
icons.description: A password gets stronger. Light: one more masked character pops into the password field, then the strength meter under it fills from weak to strong: the second bar sweeps on and stops dead, then the third. Strong: the character snaps in bigger, each bar strikes on in a quick hit with a short pause between, and the field gives one small lift when the meter is full. The meter never overshoots; the reverse empties it and removes the character.

icons.name: range-slider
icons.heading: Range slider
icons.description: A range slider is widened. Light: both handles are pressed, drag apart along the track with the selected band stretching between them, stop dead on their new values and are released; the outer bars of the histogram above light up as the range takes them in. Strong: the handles drag apart in two clicks, stopping dead at a midpoint and again at the new values, the newly included bars hop as they light up, and the handles spring on release. The values never overshoot; the reverse drags the handles back together.
